text: {"lessons":["My Stock D sale was profitable, but one good outcome does not prove that timing trades by past gains is a reliable strategy.","I added to Stock A and Stock C while already invested; before adding again, I should check position sizes and keep my portfolio diversified.","Several months of declines followed by a small rebound did not provide a clear signal, so I should stick to my long-term plan instead of reacting to short-term moves."]}
